purpose: Run-specific identity binding for the evidence-complete qualification rerun. Overlays the frozen behavioral candidate with the instrumented, executed sources. Not a release claim.

instrumentation.rule: OM_CANARY_BOOT-gated append-only traces; no new awaits, synchronization points, cleanup ordering, release eligibility, retries or timeout changes. Message construction, potentially throwing accessors, formatting and the append happen inside the guarded helper or inside a guarded thunk it resolves.
instrumentation.acceptance_rule: Astra must be able to state: instrumentation adds observations but introduces no new authority or dependency
instrumentation.repair_note: cd8b73a closes the first Astra review (verdict NOT_READY): trace helpers resolve thunks inside the guarded boundary so a throwing diagnostic can no longer replace a cleanup error (I1); drain records producer-fence completion/unavailability, registration closure and final detach with post-detach cumulative counters, and flattens nested aggregate failures (D1-D3); retained-decision traces cover the patch-capture and nested-capture routes (P1); base-release outcomes are traced without changing propagation (P2). Tracked snapshots for the un-instrumented pre-instrumentation worktree.ts baseline do not exist; the review must treat the worktree physical-cleanup delta from source inspection of the trace-guarded additions.
implemented: cleanup:skipped:retainedWorkspace on the cleanupHandle retained branch and on the patch-capture-failed and nested-capture-failed routes

cleanup:stop:invoke|ok|error and cleanup:remove:invoke|ok|error in worktree cleanupIsolation (physical teardown)

instrumented_identities.rule: re-hash the live canary files at rerun start and record the comparison before launching; any mismatch fails setup

run_identity_inventory.rule: the launcher validates every inventory entry (executable, observer/settlement-type, adapter, Brain, launcher/watcher, configuration) at the last setup boundary before spawn; missing/null/mismatched entries abort the launch. Fixture identities are validated from the preflight record; schema version and fixture hashes appear in preflight.json and the RUN-INDEX.

launcher_watcher.ownership_rule: the launcher spawns and reaps the real OMP child, captures pid/exit/timestamps, starts the watcher first and waits for its baseline acknowledgment, and stops and reaps the watcher after exit plus a bounded grace
launcher_watcher.watcher_rule: read-only (URI mode=ro); state-1/state-2 are classified from the retained backup snapshot itself; a missed intermediate state is reported state_1_missing, never reconstructed
